$comment: Phase 3 showcase keys, prepared ahead of the demo by tests/e2e/prepare-showcase-keys.ts. Every field was read from chain. The demo LOADS this file; it never retypes a hash. publicKey is the field the mirror card needs: populateKey takes the public key and the cache checks it hashes to keyId, so keyId alone cannot prove anything.

derivation.note: These are DIFFERENT values. The KeyStore, the cache and populateKey all use keyStoreKeyId. The account's getKeys() returns accountKeyHash. Querying either contract with the other's hash returns an empty entry, not an error, so a key that is plainly there reads as absent.

keys.label: showcase A: valid, prove on demand
keys.demoNote: Registered and anchored well before the demo, deliberately NOT proven. The mirror card proves it live in one step, with no anchor wait.

keys.label: showcase B: valid, then revoked
keys.demoNote: The pair. Proven valid into the mirror, then revoked on Sepolia and the revocation proven. Final state: the mirror says revoked, and that is the honest end state.

keys.label: showcase C: passkey wallet, registered session key
keys.demoNote: A passkey wallet with a registered session key. A passkey admin cannot sign an Ethereum transaction, so the registry write went through the Sepolia relay; the leg reports via=relay. Needed SDK PR #103: without it a headless passkey wallet cannot be created on Celo Sepolia at all.
keys.preparedOn: SDK PR #103 (fix/passkey-multichain-provisioning) at ac6c7ed, unmerged at the time
keys.cacheProofNote: Proven into the mirror from the test bench by an UNRELATED browser wallet (0x7AFEc44bbec63C03641f316D531bBa737aFf2E94), which demonstrates that populateKey is permissionless: the cache checks the storage proof against the anchored block and never looks at the sender. Two earlier attempts lost the anchor race first.

keys.label: passkey admin (WebAuthn P256)
keys.demoNote: The passkey wallet's own ADMIN key (WebAuthn P256, super-admin), registered and proven into the mirror by SDK PR #103. Kept because it is the only keyType 1 key in the set: it shows the mirror proving a P256 key, not just a secp256k1 one.

keys.label: showcase A spare 1: valid, prove on demand
keys.demoNote: Identical to A and equally unproven. Use it if A's proof loses the anchor race, because proving a key spends it and A has no second chance.

howToUse.mirrorCard: Pass user + publicKey. Read with isValidKey(user, keyStoreKeyId).
howToUse.timing: The mirror answers for ONE anchored L1 block, not 'now'. isValidKey requires sourceBlockNumber == IL1Block.number() exactly. A key proven earlier reads valid only while Celo still anchors that block (about 20 minutes), so the demo re-proves on demand rather than relying on a proof made hours ago.

roles.A-valid: Registered and anchored, never proven. Prove it live in one step.
roles.B-revoked: Registered, proven valid, revoked on Sepolia, revocation proven. Final: revoked.
roles.C-passkey: Passkey wallet, session key registered through the Sepolia relay, proven in.
